name: localsre
description: Lightweight local AI coding + SRE agent for VS Code. Local models (Qwen3/DeepSeek), GitHub Copilot, or Claude. 23 SRE skills, per-repo memory, 100% private.

localsre.endpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Defaults to Ollama (:11434). For llama.cpp use http://localhost:8080/v1.

localsre.model.description: Local model name. Auto-detected from the endpoint if not found (picks a Qwen model if present), so you usually do not need to set this.

localsre.temperature.description: Lower = more decisive (good for agent/coding). 0.2 recommended.

localsre.maxIterations.description: Max tool-call iterations per request before the agent stops.

localsre.autoApproveCommands.description: Run shell commands WITHOUT asking. Leave OFF for safety (assisted mode).

localsre.apiKey.description: Optional bearer token if your local endpoint requires auth. Machine-scoped.

localsre.provider.description: Model backend: 'local' = your llama.cpp/Ollama endpoint; 'copilot' = GitHub Copilot models (includes Claude); 'anthropic' = Claude via API key. Use the 'Switch Model' command to pick interactively.

localsre.anthropicApiKey.description: Optional Claude API key. Resolution order: keychain ('Set Claude API Key' command) → this setting → ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var (same one Claude Code uses; requires launching VS Code from a terminal via `code .`). Tip: Claude is also free via the 'copilot' provider if your plan includes it.

localsre.editorContext.description: Prepend the active file/selection/open tabs to each message. OFF by default — it can distract local models and crowd out important context. Turn on only if you want IDE-aware "fix this file" behavior.
